_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_dem#0. MAT_ParticleDEM takes exactly two parameters (MATERIAL_PARAM_COUNT=2, counted from the upstream deck, not assumed): INITRADIUS and INITDENSITY. Adding YOUNG to it is a MATERIALS parse error; adding YOUNG_MODULUS and POISSON_RATIO to PARTICLE DYNAMIC/DEM instead is accepted and the run finishes normally. The drafted Signal said the abort 'names neither the offending key nor the material'; execution FALSIFIED that and the entry was rewritten. What 4C really prints is a candidate list over every material it knows -- DIAGNOSTIC_IS_A_WALL=yes is a >100 threshold on the counted 'Expected group' blocks -- each re-echoing the offending entry as unused data, with no line saying the key is unknown (SAYS_KEY_IS_UNKNOWN=no) and MAT_ParticleDEM itself never offered as a candidate (OFFERS_MAT_PARTICLEDEM_AS_CANDIDATE=no). The raw line and candidate counts are printed but deliberately not asserted, so the fixture does not break when 4C gains a material. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 rebuilds every probe deck from the untouched upstream file, so the pathology is absent; unmutated the fixture PASSES, mutated it FAILS. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 bash cmd.sh`. Executed 2026-08-07 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Failed to match specification in section 'MATERIALS'
